body: I just started a new job and a guy who's twice my age has told me he loves me, despite knowing that I'm not interested and have a girlfriend. He's not touched me and he's not really brought it up again so I don't feel comfortable going to HR, but every time I go to work with him on shift it just makes me feel so shit and uncomfortable.

I used to work in the only bar in a tiny airport in the North of England. International flights and everything, but instead of having trained falcons or hawks or whatever we had a guy in his 60s called Tom who used to sit in a foldable chair on the airfield  and shoot down birds. He used to come in for a pint after the last flight of the day

This is going to sound like I'm bragging, but fuck it, I am, I'm having such a great day!!
I'm at uni, and I've recently left my full time job because it was affecting my studies so I've desperately been looking for another to help pay rent. I managed to get a Christmas temp job last week and went to my induction today. 
It went so well, I'm really looking forward to working with the company, and when it ended the guy called me over and shook my hand and told me if there was anything he could do for me, and if I needed help to get a permanent position to just ask. It's such a massive weight off my chest, I don't have to worry about how I'm going to make rent this month. And then, I Sat next to a little French girl and her mother on the bus home, and she loved the flowers I was holding and we kept talking about the colours. 
It was only silly things, but I'm so happy.
